source_text: Health consequences are severe and distinct due to the extensive scarring: immediate risks include hemorrhage (up to 20% in some cohorts), shock, and tetanus from unsterile tools, while long-term effects encompass chronic urinary tract infections, keloid formation, and obstetric complications like vesicovaginal fistulas, with a 2020 meta-analysis linking infibulation to a 30-50% increased cesarean section rate and neonatal mortality.
